summary: Arbe Robotics Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K with its unaudited interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, along with related management discussion and analysis. The filing is a routine periodic report containing standard financial data such as revenue, expenses, equity changes, and segment breakdowns, with no indication of any special corporate transaction, strategic initiative, or extraordinary event. It does not disclose any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or management departure. As a routine interim financial disclosure by a foreign private issuer, this filing does not constitute a special situation.
